dialogues.speaker: Fanwork Circle "Fantasy House"
dialogues.text: "Dear readers, how do you do? I'm Taiyaki, an author with the fan work circle 'Fantasy House.'"

dialogues.speaker: Fanwork Circle "Fantasy House"
dialogues.text: "I would like to apologize. Due to my heavy workload recently, the latest volume of 'A Country From the Center of the Earth and a Bouquet for You' will not be completed on time."

dialogues.speaker: Fanwork Circle "Fantasy House"
dialogues.text: "Owing to health concerns, I will also temporarily stop creating this particular work."

dialogues.speaker: Fanwork Circle "Fantasy House"
dialogues.text: "Thank you all for your continued support so far. I hope to see you all again."
